snippet.title: Worlde Lande Countrie - Final Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY THE DEMO HERE: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/worlde-lande-countrie-sage-24-demo.2098/
DESKTOP WALLPAPERS: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1JXUQGX9NYg0hmmF2PQRYAxQcORdQmSRn/view?usp=sharing
Your Name: Mr. Geeza
Your Aim: To Be A Massive Twit
One night at the pub, the most terrible thing happened to Mr. Geeza. He was called....
a PLONKER!!!
"Who would do such a thing?!", you might be asking? A despicable little bloke named "Quingale"!
With Qwargelo as his new arch-nemesis, Mr. Geeza plans to get his revenge, by ruining Quinging's cereal with Hot Sauce!
But little does Mr. Geeza know, that something strange is brewing in that pub....
Fonts Used:
m6x11plus by Daniel Linssen
Crunchycons by SPOICAT
